paper.title_en: Signatures of Novikov-Thorne accretion disks around rotating black holes in semiclassical gravity with trace anomaly
paper.abstract_en: Semiclassical gravity provides a promising framework to address the black hole singularity problem through quantum backreaction characterized by a coupling parameter, making it essential to thoroughly explore the accretion properties around such objects. In this paper, within the framework of semiclassical gravity with type-A trace anomaly, we investigate the thermal radiative signatures of Novikov-Thorne accretion disks around rotating black holes across diverse parameter spaces, focusing on the energy flux density, temperature profile, and thermal luminosity. Our findings demonstrate that the introduction of a positive coupling parameter suppresses disk emission, leading to lower peak values of both energy flux density and temperature, as well as lower peak values and corresponding peak frequencies in thermal luminosity compared to their Kerr counterparts in general relativity. In particular, this discrepancy becomes remarkably pronounced when the black hole possesses a high spin. Mechanistically, increasing the coupling parameter reinforces the effective gravitational field strength of the central compact object, which pushes the equatorial stable circular orbits outward and increases the specific energy of the orbiting matter, thereby reducing the radiative efficiency and weakening the overall disk emission. This suppression mechanism offers a potential astrophysical window to distinguish semiclassical gravity from general relativity and to place observational constraints on the coupling parameter via thermal disk spectra.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在带type-A迹反常的半经典引力框架下研究旋转黑洞周围的Novikov-Thorne吸积盘热辐射特征，系统分析能量通量密度、温度分布与热光度，并给出正耦合参数抑制盘发射的机制及对赤道稳定圆轨道与比能的影响；理论深度较好、论证链条清晰，且提供了区分半经典引力与广义相对论的潜在天文观测窗口，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 带迹反常的半经典引力中旋转黑洞周围Novikov-Thorne吸积盘的签名
decision.abstract_zh: 半经典引力提供了一个有前景的框架，通过以耦合参数为特征的量子反作用来解决黑洞奇点问题，因此彻底探究此类天体周围的吸积性质至关重要。在本文中，我们在带type-A迹反常的半经典引力框架下，研究旋转黑洞周围Novikov-Thorne吸积盘在多种参数空间中的热辐射签名，重点关注能量通量密度、温度分布和热光度。我们的结果表明，引入正耦合参数会抑制盘发射，导致能量通量密度和温度的峰值均较低，并且与广义相对论中的Kerr对应物相比，热光度的峰值及相应的峰值频率也较低。特别是，当黑洞具有高自旋时，这种差异变得非常显著。从机制上看，增大耦合参数会增强中心致密天体的有效引力场强度，这将赤道稳定圆轨道向外推并增大轨道物质的比能，从而降低辐射效率并削弱整体盘发射。这种抑制机制为区分半经典引力与广义相对论提供了一个潜在的天体物理窗口，并可通过热盘光谱对耦合参数施加观测约束。
